data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 唱片店的试听
data.description: 唱片店里，她把耳机的一侧贴近耳朵，低头查看手中的专辑封面。
data.action: listening with headphones and holding an album cover
data.promptProse: At a listening station in a retro record store, Setsuna Ogiso holds oversized headphones against her ears, smiling radiantly as her hands rest on the listening counter. Shelves of colorful CD cases, indie music posters, and warm pendant store lights surround her.
